pulse.currentFocus: S310 rebuilt The Desk's public numbers and added reader signal. Every published figure is now derived by lib/news-stats.mjs into a byte-checked api/news-desk-stats.json that the renderer reads, so page and feed cannot disagree; accuracy renders 'Not yet — a record needs 4' rather than a flattering percentage off a thin sample, and sources count unique publishers. The founder flagged the canned 'The desk disagrees' line: it was TRUE on the two stories where it appeared but meaningless on the other three, which have a single voice, so it is replaced by a stance axis plotting each voice where it actually stands. Reader reactions ship as editorial signal — Changed my mind / Already knew this / Show more receipts / Made me laugh plus a per-voice vote feeding ORSON's Director's Report — identity-free, with counts rendered only when the server returns them. Each persona's prose now uses the visual register it already owns in its panel. A founder-reported crude cartoon (torso running past the leg join) was fixed and re-rendered. THE ENDPOINT IS NOT LIVE: it ships in the Worker, whose promotion gate holds on real-provider-e2e-pending, and the Ark inbox revealed why that can never clear as-is — this site is on v1/hand-rolled auth with no Obelisk sign-in control at all, and 0/43 relying parties are live on Passport v2. Migration deferred to its own session by the founder; a repo-question is with Obelisk about a live-rejected staging callback they report as registered.
pulse.nextMilestone: Gate that a rendered stat equals its derived source, then run the founder-scheduled Obelisk Passport v2 migration, which unblocks the Worker promotion hold, reader-reaction counts, and the member account shell together.
blockers: release gate: production callback https://vaultsparkstudios.com/auth/callback is registered, but client vaultsparkstudios-website still rejects https://website.staging.vaultsparkstudios.com/auth/callback as unregistered
real-provider-e2e: one founder sign-in remains after staging callback registration; public enrollment copy remains provider-gated
full-site deploy currency: production intentionally retains baseline 4a72961d because only the identity-isolated content partition (215 paths) was promoted
AI discovery completion: sitemap.xml, agents.json, and .well-known discovery changes await the full-site release because the static content lane rejects root discovery/config files

deploy-currency baseline: api/deploy-currency.json carries deployedSha null / state unobserved because the production probe is Cloudflare-challenge-bound, so the content lane cannot self-compute its diff range and required an explicit baseline_sha (read from the served /api/build-sha.json)
The Dispatch has zero confirmed subscribers until the founder clicks the double-opt-in confirmation email — Brevo attaches a contact to the list only after that click, and no agent can close that leg

Obelisk Passport v2: this site has NO Obelisk sign-in control and is one of 0/43 relying parties still on v1, so the real-provider-e2e journey cannot be verified and the Worker promotion gate cannot clear. Migration deferred to its own session by the founder; repo-question with Obelisk on a staging callback they report registered but which probes live as redirect-not-registered.
